strings.en: You trash! Disappear! Just disappear!
Die and become a feather in my cap!
I'll kill you, you bastard!
Die! Just die already!
I'll crush you, you trash!
Knights or whatever, I don't care anymore!/　As long as I can kill you all!
So you're my enemy!/　Fine, I'll smash you to pieces!
Disappear!/　Disappear without a trace, you bastard!
I'll kill you, I'll kill you myself!!
I'll slaughter you all, Steel Dragons!
Disappear, vanish, you trash!!
Disappear, disappear!/　Vanish without a trace, all of you!!
Die before you even get a chance to regret it!
Still hanging around there, scum?!
Just shut up and die!
Who do you think you're messing with, huh?!
Quit resisting!
I said you're not getting away, trash!
I can't stand the very fact that you exist!
Annoying! Annoying, annoying!!
I'll kill you! I'll kill you! All of you!
It's you! Because of you, I...!!
Calvina!/　You're one I won't hand over to anyone else!
It's you...!/　More than anyone, I want you dead first!!
Everything's your fault!/　Die, Calvina! By my own hand!!
You're still alive?!/　Die right here, right now, Calvina!
Calvinaaa!/　If it weren't for you! If it weren't for you!!
I'll kill you! Kill, kill, kill, kill!/　Calvinaaa!
You piloting the Granteed Dracodeus.../　is something that should never be!
Filth like you has no right/　to use a Throne Unit!
You and the Princess are both enemies!/　Enemies, enemies, enemies!
Throne Unit or Princess, I don't care!/　If you're going to be my enemy!!
Shana-Miaaa!/　How long are you going to torment us?!/　Huh?!
You're starting to be an eyesore too!/　Disappear! Just disappear, you fake!
That color, that system! It all pisses me off!/　Get out of my sight!
I'll kill you, fake system and all!!
You too?!/　You're lending your power to this trash too?!
N-No way!/　Trash like you broke the Larseilam?!
Get out of my space!
Damn it! I'll crush you, new model!
I can't let you go,/　not after you broke the Larseilam!
An Earthling breaking the Larseilam.../　that should never happen!
Annoying! You're really getting annoying!/　You fake Hückebein!!
Disappear!/　I said disappear, you damn Hückebein!
Vaula!/　I'll wipe you out without leaving a speck of dust!
Th-This is absurd!!
D-Damn iiit!!
Gwaaagh!!
Gah! Damn iiit!!
I-It's impossible/　that I'm inferior to you!!
I won't accept it! How could I accept this?!
Ngh!/　I'm an Agent! I can't make a fool of myself like this!!
Damn it!/　There's no way I'd lose to the likes of you!!
Steel Dragons or whatever,/　I'm not losing!!
I won't fall! I won't fall, I won't fall!/　Not until I've killed you all!!
Damn it! Damn, damn it!!/　I won't let you! I won't let you!!
Ngh! Like this?!/　Like hell I'm ending it here!!
No matter how the Bellzelute's been upgraded,/　my Coustwell won't lose!!
Gah!/　Calvina, you're mine to kill!!
C-Calvina! You bastaaard!!
Ngh! No matter what,/　I'll take the Granteed Dracodeus...!!
Shana-Miaaa!/　Don't think you can beat me!!
Ugaaah!/　Shana-Mia, you of all people...!!
Y-You and Calvina.../　I'll never forgive you!!
Damn it, damn it!/　You're the one who dies! It's you!!
You trash! Don't think you can beat me/　like you did Vaula!!
Y-You're still interfering/　with my Cytron System?!
Just because you broke the Larseilam,/　don't think you can beat me!!
L-Like I'll let you do as you please/　again and again, you claw freak!!
Not bad for a bunch of trash!
Damn it, I won't end it on the losing end!
Ngh! Get out of my way!
Don't screw with me! Like you could kill me!
You bastards, getting in my way at every turn!!
You bastaaards! Screwing with meee!!
Gaaah! I won't forgive you!/　I won't forgive you, I won't!!
Damn it! You damn bastards!!
Ngh! Those add-on parts!!
Damn it, this can't be!/　Me, inferior to Calvina now?!
I won't let you! I said I won't let you!/　Calvinaaa!!
Damn it!/　That Granteed Dracodeus/　doesn't belong to you!!
Tch!/　You're trying to kill me, Princess?!
Sh-Shana-Miaaa!/　What the hell are you?!
Tch! I can't handle the Aurun?!
Don't you look down on me! Al-Vaaan!!
Don't screw with me!/　A fake like you, against me?!
Damn it! Like I'd lose/　to some copy system!!
Th-This is my space!/　Like I'd let you do as you please!!
Damn it! The Larseilam doesn't work on that one,/　so I have to take it down here!
Damn it! You hit me!
So what, you idiot?!
Butting in, are you?! I'll kill you!
Annoying! You're damn annoying!
Like that'd make me flinch!
So weak! Weak, weak!!
It's a pointless struggle!!
You think you can kill me with that?!
Even after the upgrade,/　that's all the Bellzelute's got?!
Tch!/　Damn Bellzelute, it's gotten faster!
Hah, is that all?!/　Just die already, Calvinaaa!
Like you could ever kill me,/　Calvinaaa!!
Ngh! To think she can handle/　the Granteed Dracodeus like that!
The Princess, siding with the Earthlings!
Throne Unit or whatever!/　Nothing can stop me now!!
Ngh! You've got no just cause!
You're trying to kill me?! You?!
Ngh! Don't interfere with me!
Tch! Stay out/　of my Cytron System!
Tch!/　Not just moving, but landing hits too?!
Tch! You piss me off, you clawed freak!
Damn you, Vaula, screwing with me!
Like that'd hit! Don't underestimate me!
Hahaha! Idiot!
No matter what the likes of you try!
Missed, missed! You missed!!
Miss! Miss, miiiss!!
I know your patterns,/　Calvina!!
Hahaha!/　What are you doing, Calvinaaa!
Calvina, you'll die!/　I'll kill you!!
Hah, what's wrong?!/　That's all, even with the Basileus?!
Who cares about a Throne Unit, idiot!!
Missed!/　I'm not the same as before, you know!
You can't kill me!!
Use a copy of the Cytron System all you want,/　it's no good if you can't hit!
To think it can move/　inside the Stasis Field...!!
Don't get cocky just because/　you broke the Larseilam!
Like attacks from trash could hit me!
It's useless, you trash!
That kind of thing won't work on me!
Go ahead, do all you want, small fry!
Quit wasting your time/　and hurry up and die!
Useless! Useless, useless!!
Doesn't work! Doesn't work at all!!
Tch, you got lucky!
I can't attack?! You've got to be kidding!
This is really pissing me off!
Gaaah! Damn it!!
Where'd that bastard go!?
Quit running, you bastard!!
Come on out, hey!
Tch! I can't touch them?!
Don't you run away, you bastard!!
That one's mine to kill!!
That prey is mine!
Like I'd let you get away!!
Hey! Get out of the way!
I'm your opponent!
I said I'm your opponent!!
I said you're not getting away, slowpoke!
Too slow! You're too slow, trash!
Die! I said die, you scum!
Go down, go down!!
Eat thiiis!
Get shot through!!
I said get blown away!!
Go down! Go down! Go dooown!!
I said I'll kill youuu!!
There you aaare!!
I'll crush you! With this!
Orgone Claw!
This range... It's mine!
I'll slam this into you!!
Crush! Crush, crush!!
I said I'll crush youuu!!
Come on, come on, come on!
Go down, you scum!!
Struggle, struggle!!
Idiot! Over here!!
Hyahahahaha!!
Diiie!!
Hahaha! Burn to cinders!!
There's nowhere to run!
Disappear, disappear, disappear!!
I'll slice you up with this!!
The Knights' code means nothing to me anymore!!
I'll cut you down with this!
Take that!
This is the end, trash!!
You're dead!!
No matter what it takes!!
Raaagh!
Drop dead!!
I'll slice you up with this!!
I'll chop you to bits!
Don't you move!
Not yet!!
Raah!
One more!
Die!
Die, die!!
Here I goooo!!
Orgonite Knuckle!!
I'll break you with this!
Ooooooh!!
Haaaaaah!!
Break apart!!
Come on, come on, come on!!
Crush, crush, crush, cruuush!!
Brace yourself!!
Orgonite Shadow!
Eat this!
I said I'll kill you!!
Come out, my Afterimages!!
It's not over yet!
I'll pound you all at once!!
Raaaaagh!!
This'll finish it!
Come, Broken Arm!
All right!
Orgone Materialization!
I'll kill you! I'll kill you!!
With this!!
Brace yourseeelf!!
Take that!
Hraaah!!
Get blown away!!
Come on, come on, come on!!
Raaaaaah!!
Gotcha!!
This ends now!!
Shatter to pieeeces!!
Raaagh!!
Take thiiis!!
I'll beat you to a pulp!!
It's over!!
Get crushed!!
